{{Top|leg}}
A '''Ring-city''' was a type of [[City/Legends|city]] that could be found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kaikielius/Legends|Kaikielius]].

==History==
In [[4225 BBY]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Odominic]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] began supplying [[Black market/Legends|black market]] arms to [[Kaikielius/Legends|Kaikielius]], resulting in a war in the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] ring-[[City/Legends|cities]], between criminals and the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] sent [[Troop/Legends|troops]] to Kaikielius to intervene and they attacked the most criminal-infested ring-cities.
